QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: zoomStep
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Tap sends one step. Holding repeats only after the camera confirms the previous target. Intermediate moves use the full configured step from the 1.0x grid. If the next full step would cross the fractional camera limit, one boundary move snaps to 5.5x for 1080p or 3.5x for 2K; zooming out from that limit first returns to 5.0x or 3.0x, then continues by full steps.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: mavlinkAutoVideoStream
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, QGC uses the video URI reported by MAVLink and locks manual video source editing. Restart QGC after changing this option.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: forceAndroidH265HardwareDecoder
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: On Android, register a low-latency hvc1-to-byte-stream adapter and prioritize a compatible vendor MediaCodec H.265 decoder. Software decoder ranks remain available for fallback. Restart QGC after changing this option.
